function.name: triangle_properties_get
function.description: Retrieve a triangle's dimensions, such as area and perimeter, given three side lengths. Unlike circle_properties_get, which retrieves the dimensions, such as area and circumference, of a circle if radius is given, this retrieves the dimensions, such as area and perimeter, of a triangle if lengths of three sides are given.

get_angles.description: Whether to calculate the internal angles.

function.name: circle_properties_get
function.description: Retrieve a circle's dimensions, such as area and circumference, given its radius. Unlike triangle_properties_get, which retrieves the dimensions, such as area and perimeter, of a triangle if lengths of three sides are given, this retrieves the dimensions, such as area and circumference, of a circle if radius is given.

radius.description: The length of radius of the circle. This is a float type value.
